run_trl_cli: run the TRL CLI main entry point with optional argv list to execute subcommands
build_argparse_parser: build an ArgumentParser with subparsers registered from a list of Command objects
get_trl_commands: get the list of registered TRL CLI commands including dpo, grpo, kto, reward, rloo, sft, env, skills, and vllm_serve
create_command_context: create a CommandContext with argv list to extract subcommand arguments via argv_after
run_command: run a registered TRL CLI command with parsed args and command context returning an exit code
